name: SATURN
fix_description: In autoLiquidityPairTokens, addLiquidity uses 0 minimum amounts. Fix: set reasonable minimum based on oracle price.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step chain involving privileged token configuration changes, token acquisition from a holder, a flash loan, AMM reserve/balance desync, and a block-roll timing detail before draining value. It is not deeply complex protocol-wise, but it requires understanding token-specific sell-limit logic and PancakeSwap pair mechanics, making it more than a straightforward single-pattern exploit.
